tests.stimulus: Instantiate the complete top with the above parameters fixed; seeds drive different random RGB histories; interleave all 8 modes with split screen, blanking, and vsync.
tests.expected: Native port behavior follows the subsequent requirements; every input cycle is consumed, with no handshake stalls.
tests.checker: The native independent model receives the same inputs; the scoreboard compares all defined outputs every cycle and counts actual comparison points. All inputs in this test are driven on the falling edge of clk and held until the next rising edge; four-state sampling occurs 0.2ns after the rising edge, after NBA has settled. The predictor first saves pre-edge state and inputs, computes each stage's next value separately, and compares the defined top-level outputs after that edge, without assuming that data and control have the same latency.

tests.stimulus: Apply low reset for 4 cycles at power-up; after 64 lines of streaming, drive it low on a falling edge, hold it for 4 cycles, and release it, then continue threshold data.
tests.expected: All outputs are 0 after two reset edges; between edges, previously registered values are held; state returns to defaults while RAM is not cleared. At 0.2ns after the falling edge before synchronous reset, previously registered outputs must still be held; they become zero only at 0.2ns after the rising edge.

tests.stimulus: By default, naturally hold sw3/btn1 for more than 2500001 cycles to obtain 133; extended holds for additional slots to verify that no repeated firing occurs, switches to other modes to naturally release prev, then uses sw3/btn3 to verify increment priority, and uses btn2 after a release slot to verify decrement; saturation uses natural pulses on the instance to reach 255/0 and applies additional pulses. Supplement with btn0 pulses narrower than 2500001 cycles that do not cover a sampling slot, brief releases and re-presses between sampling slots, btn[3:2] switching, and isolated btn1 pulses for Gaussian/Sobel, checking that the threshold or mode does not change.
tests.expected: Default 128→133; extended long hold remains 133, simultaneous rising edges→138, decrement→133; saturation has an upper bound of 255 and a lower bound of 0 and remains unchanged on another operation in the same direction. Each 2500001-cycle slot uses the pre-edge count and prev; a long hold produces no new edge; an unsampled release does not establish a new prev=0; data on the threshold-changing edge still uses the old threshold.
